spec.title: Unencrypted data at rest
spec.summary: A datastore holds confidential data without disk- or DBMS-level encryption. Compromise of the underlying media, a snapshot, or a backup discloses the data directly.
spec.attacker_goal: Obtain confidential data without compromising the application.
attack_vectors: Theft or improper disposal of physical media
Access to a publicly exposed snapshot or backup
spec.false_positives: Data is already encrypted at the application layer before being written — closed by CM-APP-LEVEL-ENCRYPTION.
